title: 1986 AHSME Problem 16
statement: In \(\triangle ABC,\) \(AB=8,\) \(BC=7,\) \(CA=6\) and side \(BC\) is extended, as shown in the figure, to a point \(P\) so that \(\triangle PAB\) is similar to \(\triangle PCA.\) The length of \(PC\) is

solutions.text:
The stated order of similarity gives \[ \frac{PA}{PC}=\frac{PB}{PA}=\frac{AB}{CA}=\frac43. \] Let \(PC=t.\) Then \(PA=\frac{4t}{3}\) and \(PB=\frac{16t}{9}.\) Since \(PB=PC+CB=t+7,\) \[ \frac{16t}{9}=t+7, \] which gives \(t=9.\)

Thus the correct answer is C.
hints: Use the vertex order in \(\triangle PAB\sim\triangle PCA\) to match corresponding sides
